name: After recital N
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: Nb. whereas the military and defence sector is one of the largest global emitters of greenhouse gases, yet remains largely exempt from mandatory public reporting on its carbon footprint; whereas the carbon footprint of military expenditure in the EU alone was estimated at 24.8 million tonnes of CO₂ equivalent in 2019, comparable to the annual emissions of approximately 14 million cars; whereas the military sector’s increasing reliance on fossil fuels and resource-intensive equipment exacerbates the climate crisis, while diverting funds from urgent social and environmental investments;
